description: This Java class provides utility methods for evaluating mathematical expressions using the JEP (Java Expression Parser) library. It includes methods to evaluate expressions with a single variable 'x' or with a set of named variables provided in a map.

classes.name: JEPUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for evaluating mathematical expressions with the JEP library.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression string with a single variable 'x' replaced by a provided double value.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression string with multiple variables provided in a map of variable names to values.
